entries.name: AI Playbook for the UK Government
entries.one_liner: 10 principles and guidance for safe, effective AI use across the public sector

entries.name: AWS Activate (open)
entries.access: Founders tier self-serve; Portfolio via Activate Provider Org ID
entries.one_liner: AWS credits up to ~$200k for startups, usable on Bedrock models

entries.name: European Digital Innovation Hubs (EDIH)
entries.access: Contact a regional EDIH for test-before-invest, training and funding help
entries.one_liner: 169 EU hubs helping SMEs and public bodies test and adopt AI

entries.name: Google for Startups Cloud Program (AI tier)
entries.access: Apply online; pre-seed to Series A with known investor
entries.one_liner: Up to $350k Google Cloud credits for AI startups (incl. Gemini usage)

entries.name: IndiaAI Startups Global
entries.steward: IndiaAI Mission with Station F and HEC Paris
entries.access: Annual application on indiaai.gov.in; 10 startups per cohort
entries.one_liner: Four-month Station F acceleration for Indian AI startups entering Europe

entries.name: Microsoft for Startups (open)
entries.access: $5k self-serve Azure credits; ~$100k via investor-network referral
entries.one_liner: Azure credits and support for startups; Founders Hub retired July 2025
entries.note: July 2025: open tier cut to $5k; larger credits need an investor-network referral code

entries.name: NVIDIA Inception (open)
entries.access: Free to join; incorporated, under 10 years old, working website
entries.one_liner: Free startup programme with cloud credits, DLI training, hardware discounts and VC intros
